mailbox.domainHint: Tip: do not use your company's main domain for first contact. Use a separate sending domain (a second domain is safest, otherwise a subdomain) with SPF, DKIM and DMARC, and start with only a few emails per day. That way your normal business mail stays unaffected if spam filters react.

pro.dialogHint: This feature is part of MixMarket Pro. Everything else in MixMarket stays free.

tours.title: Guided tours
tours.desc: Tours take you step by step through every task in MixMarket: field by field, with your real data. At the end the product, the search or the campaign really exists.

autopilot.title: Autopilot
autopilot.desc: The autopilot analyses finished searches, rates target groups with the AI and hands matching companies to the outbox on its own. You only approve.

followUps.title: Follow-up emails
followUps.desc: If a company does not answer, the AI writes a follow-up email in the same thread after the set interval, up to three.

automations.title: Automations
automations.desc: Automations send recipients of a campaign a follow-up email on their own, for example when they opened the email, clicked a link or did not open it.

approveAll.title: Approve all
approveAll.desc: Approves all reviewed emails in the outbox with one click instead of one by one.

inboxAi.title: AI in conversations
inboxAi.desc: The AI sorts every reply (interest, question, rejection, unsubscribe) and drafts an answer right away for interest or questions.

paidSources.title: Paid search sources
paidSources.desc: Company search also via DataForSEO and Serper: Google business profiles with phone, website and rating, or Google search with ranking.

templatePacks.title: Template packs
templatePacks.desc: Ready-made templates and outreach settings per industry, taken over with one click and ready to use.
